The defect is in `window_report.py:15`: the end comparison is exclusive (`< end`). It should be `<= end` so both endpoints, including equal endpoints, are included. The empty-window result would remain unchanged.

I can’t apply the repair in this read-only environment. No files were changed, and the tests have not been run. Once the file is writable, make that one-character change and run `python -m unittest -v test_window_report.py`.
